I replied in #coastal-team, in your thread.

The official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics was November 3, 2025. Moss's 2025-11-02 Coastal digest says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03", and your cutover recap (dated 2025-12-08) gives the same official handoff date.

Your recap also says you kept running PHL day to day until November 21, and that Kwame Adjei-Rowe fully took over on November 22, 2025. If the tracker needs the date Kwame took full day-to-day ownership, use November 22. The digest itself doesn't name Kwame, so the recap is the source for that part.
